graph_note: Signed one-session lag associations of active-stock returns after subtracting the observed-universe daily mean. Same sign and minimum absolute correlation in both training halves; graph frozen before calibration/evaluation. Associations are not causality.
comparison_note: The real peer graph must beat a degree/weight-matched shuffled graph, the already-fitted local NCP, and a GRU with identical real peer inputs. Same original candidate pool and fixed fitting endpoints.
